XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: OBD and/or SCR warning light comes on, "Check emissions" and/or "emissions lock" warning appears on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: 63435 | INJECTION | PROBE | LAMBDA | MOUNT | CATALYST | MIL | WARNING LIGHTS | FAULT | 224441 | NOX | OXYGEN | GAS | EXHAUST | SERVICE | 220016 | 220017 | 114E41 | 14A016 | 14A017 |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Euro 6DTemp cars manufactured from 01/01/17 to 31/12/25

  • System: Injection

  • Component: Upstream lambda sensor

  • Fault: OBD and/or SCR warning light illuminated, message on display stating ‘Check emission control system’ and/or ‘Emission control lockout in XXX km’

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • Upstream lambda sensor: 224441, 220016, 220017
    • Lambda sensor downstream of the catalytic converter: 114E41, 14A016, 14A017
  • Cause: Damaged lambda sensors and associated wiring

• Action: Replace the faulty lambda sensor

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: If the lambda probe wiring is damaged, apply a protective ring sleeve (product code 540684042R) to the probe wiring, securing the ends with cable ties.
